name: Fernco Non-Return Valve for DN100 Pipes
description: The Fernco Non-Return Valve allows sewers or surface water materials to freely flow in the direction of the drainage systems mains but block backflow of those materials in the opposite direction in instances, such as, flooding. Can be installed directly into existing manholes by simply pushing the NRV into the desired pipe inlet. Prevents foul water flowing back from the blocked sewerage systems to flood the property from the inside via toilets, plug holes and waste pipes. The design features of the NRV also make this device ideal in pest control scenarios, acting as a rat blocker as well as a flood control device.

description: The FloPlast Soil Pipe Strap on Pipe Connector allows you to add a waste pipe to a soil system without the use of a fitting. Simple calculate the point at which you want the waste pipe to enter the soil pipe, cut a hole in the pipe using a 54-56mm hole cutter and locate strap boss.
